raw_segments.text: A tax upon house rent, payable by the tenant, and proportion to the whole rent of each house,
could not, for any considerable time at least, affect the building rent.
If the builder did not get his reasonable profit, he would be obliged to quit the trade—which,
by raising the demand for building, would, in a short time, bring back his profit to
its proper level with that of other trades.
